```{r}
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  sf,
  mapview
)

```

# Data

```{r}
alt= st_read("../outputs/shapefile/2026-05-13_FireAltPoints.shp")

```

# View

```{r}
alt
```


```{r}
mapview(alt)
```


# Clustered study areas

```{r}
hulls <- alt |>
  dplyr::group_by(cntryId) |>
  dplyr::summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) |>
  st_convex_hull()
```




```{r}

mapview(hulls)
```

```{r}
st_write(hulls, "../outputs/study_area/FCS_FireALT_studyAreaBoxes.shp", driver="ESRI Shapefile")
```
